violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM ON SITE WHEN EHS ARRIVED.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN COFFEE AREA WITH A JUG OF MILK AND A SPOON IN IT. A SPONGE WAS ON THE SIDE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED DURING INSPECTION. CEASE USING HANDWASHING SINK FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: “CREAM” MIXTURE MADE WITH RAW EGG, SUGAR, AND UNSALTED BUTTER WAS OBSERVED BEING STORED ON THE COUNTER AND AT 68F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CREAM THROWN AWAY. PLEASE KEEP IT IN THE COOLER OR KEEP IT ABOVE 135F.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED MULTIPLE SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF FOOD DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: FOOD BOTTLES LABELED.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED RODENT DROPPINGS ON SHELVING, ON FOOD CONTAINERS, ON THE FLOOR, AND INSIDE CUPBOARDS.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. YOU MUST GET PEST CONTROL ON OR BEFORE NOVEMBER 15TH. PEST CONTROL INVOICE MUST INDICATE THE FACILITY HAS BEEN TREATED PROPERLY. PLEASE SEND ME THE INVOICE AFTER SERVICE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: OBSERVED MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS OF FOOD THROUGHOUT FACILITY BEING REUSED.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. STOP REUSING CREAM CHEESE, BAKING POWDER CONTAINERS, AND ANY OTHER MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS FOR FOOD. UTILIZE NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS OR THE EQUIVALENT. THE METAL CONTAINERS IN FACILITY ARE ADEQUATE.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: COUNTERS, SHELVES, OUTSIDE OF PLASTICWARE
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: FLOORS AND WALLS OF FACILITY HAVE A SIGNIFICANT AMOUNT OF FOOD DEBRIS ON THEM.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the front of the kitchen being used to wash a rag
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS HAD EMPLOYEE STOP WASHING THE RAG AT THE HAND SINK AND EXPLAINED THAT HAND SINKS ARE ONLY FOR HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO SOAP AT THE HAND SINK IN THE BACK OF THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC REPLACED HAND SOAP.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: heavy cream (47°F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC WILL PROVIDE EVIDENCE OF THE PURCHASE OF A FOOD THERMOMETER WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sugar and flour in buckets
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
